ctx.x: Well, to tell the truth, he played with me in my band. I had a band. He worked with me. Then a couple of times he worked with Jack Carey. Who?
What was he playing in those days?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: He'd play with us up there.

ctx.x: Now, back to the piano players. What about Manuel Bonetta? Did you ever work with him?
Yeah. Like, we'd go up to the Audubon, Turon, places like that where they'd need piano players. He'd play with us up there. He was a real good piano player. But otherwise, we didn't use no piano.
Now, who were some of the good piano players in either solo or band that you'd say were really outstanding here?
